definitions.explanation: a prepared area of soil where seeds are sown and seedlings are raised before being transplanted to their final growing location

examples.japanese: {苗床|なえどこ}に{種|たね}をまく。
{苗床|なえどこ}で{育|そだ}てた{苗|なえ}を{畑|はたけ}に{植|う}え{替|か}える。
examples.english: Transplant the seedlings raised in the nursery bed to the field.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になったら{苗床|なえどこ}を{準備|じゅんび}して、トマトの{種|たね}をまく{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: When spring comes, I plan to prepare the seedbed and sow tomato seeds.

notes:
{苗床|なえどこ} is a seedbed — a prepared area where seeds are germinated and seedlings grown before transplanting to their final location. Composed of {苗|なえ} (seedling) + {床|どこ} (bed, floor).

USAGE:
Can refer to a dedicated garden bed, a greenhouse nursery tray, or any controlled environment for starting seeds. Also used figuratively: 〜の{苗床|なえどこ} (a breeding ground/nursery for ~).

FIGURATIVE USE:
- {犯罪|はんざい}の{苗床|なえどこ}: a breeding ground for crime
- {才能|さいのう}の{苗床|なえどこ}: a nursery for talent

RELATED TERMS:
- {苗|なえ}: seedling
- {種|たね}まき: seed sowing
- {植|う}え{替|か}え: transplanting
- {育苗|いくびょう}: seedling cultivation (technical)
- {温床|おんしょう}: hotbed (also figurative: breeding ground)
